subject: Confirm {{invitedEmail}} to join your Tribe
body:
Hello,

You already have an account with this address, and it has not been confirmed yet. Confirm it and your invite will go through.

Confirm this address: {{verifyUrl}}

Then open your invite again: {{claimUrl}}

Your invite stays live in the meantime, so there is no rush and nothing to re-request.

Thank you,
Auntie
